description: Sync an Obsidian vault to memory. Scans for markdown files, extracts frontmatter/tags/wiki-links, embeds content, and stores as searchable memories. Uses incremental sync based on file modification times.

chunk_overlap.description: Overlap between chunks in characters for context preservation

chunk_size.description: Target chunk size in characters for large files (~4 chars per token)

exclude_patterns.description: Skip files matching these glob patterns (e.g., ["templates/**", "daily/**"])

force.description: If true, re-sync all files regardless of modification time

include_patterns.description: Only sync files matching these glob patterns (e.g., ["notes/**", "projects/**"])

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault directory

name: vault_sync
